description: React component 'MCPToolPermissions' for managing permissions related to MCP tools on MCP servers, including fetching server details and associated tools, handling user selections, and displaying server and tool information.

classes.name: MCPToolPermissionsProps
classes.description: TypeScript interface defining props for the MCPToolPermissions React component.

methods.name: fetchToolsForServer
methods.description: Fetches tools for a specific server and updates the component state.

methods.description: Handles toggling a tool's checkbox, updating permissions.

methods.description: Selects all available tools for a server.

methods.name: handleDeselectAll
methods.description: Deselects all tools for a server.
